component.name: Whether
component.summary: Weather forecasts, air quality, and alerts for the COSMIC panel

description.p: Whether is a weather applet for the COSMIC desktop panel, showing current conditions, hourly and 7-day forecasts, air quality, and weather alerts for locations worldwide.
Weather data is sourced automatically by location via weathervane — NWS in the United States, JMA in Japan, and Open-Meteo elsewhere.

ul.li: Current conditions: temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind and gusts, precipitation, AQI, and UV index
Expandable detail: dew point, pressure, and the pollutant breakdown (PM2.5, PM10, ozone)
Hourly and 7-day forecasts, with per-day wind, precipitation, and sunrise/sunset
Location search with multiple saved locations

screenshot.caption: Current conditions and forecast with imperial units (United States)
Active weather alert with metric units (Germany)

ul.li: Adopted weathervane backend for global weather data sources
Added pressure, dew point, UV index, and sunrise/sunset

description.p: Updated COSMIC/libcosmic dependencies, added Swedish localization.
